description: Lead read-and-approve decisions for the Stage B exception registry (scripts/design-system/registry-merge.mjs --decisions). registry-verify.mjs auto-classifies only boundaries shaped "Component#prop"; every other shape needs a lead to read the call site and record a verdict here with the evidence they read. Tracked in the repo rather than under dist/ because a fresh checkout cannot rebuild the ledger without it.

decisions.category: safe-area env() with validated closed-scale fallback
decisions.evidence: line 3599: the scanner emits this extension-boundary only AFTER validating the fallback term (spacing.mjs::analyzeEnvironmentSpacing runs analyzeSpacingTerm on it and reports a boundary only when that produced no finding), so var(--space-0) is a registered scale value. The inset itself is device-reported at runtime and cannot be on any closed scale, which is why the rule is a boundary rather than debt.
